catalog.summary: Month, week, day and list views of events.

pattern.title: Grid (Interactive Tabular Data and Layout Containers) Pattern
pattern.absent: WAI-ARIA APG has no pattern for an event calendar; the layout grid whose cells contain widgets is the closest, with the day as the cell
sections: Editing and Navigating Inside a Cell

composesNot.button: button fixes its own data-part to root, so it cannot carry previous, today, next or filter; the family draws the four with the control tokens and masked glyphs, the precedent of calendar and pagination

roleReason: The root holds a toolbar, a heading and a grid or a list; the grid is the widget, and a role on the root would name the whole thing twice.

anatomy.root: div; container slotted-event-calendar; data-view, data-layout, data-loading
anatomy.header: div; the heading and the controls that move the calendar
anatomy.title: h2 by default (level); the period in view; its own polite live region; names the grid
anatomy.previous: button; one period back; chevron glyph mirrored in RTL
anatomy.today: button; to the period holding today in the calendar's zone
anatomy.views: segmented-control of the offered views; absent with one view
anatomy.filter: menu trigger; checkbox items, one per calendar, with its swatch; absent with fewer than two calendars
anatomy.body: div; aria-busy while loading; the grid or the list
anatomy.loader: div; an indeterminate linear progress-indicator on the body's top edge, after loadingDelay
anatomy.error: div; the consumer's message and retry, above the grid, which stays usable
anatomy.week-number-header: th; the week-number column's header, visually hidden text
anatomy.weekday: th scope=col; short weekday name; abbr holds the full name
anatomy.week: tr; one week row; --slotted-event-calendar-lanes on it
anatomy.day: td role=gridcell; roving tabindex; data-today, data-outside-month, data-selected, data-offset-change
anatomy.day-number: button tabindex=-1; drills down to the day view; full date as its name
anatomy.day-content: div; the consumer's content for the day — a holiday, a price, a count of free slots — from renderDayContent; in the month's day header and under the date of a column header
anatomy.day-events: div; lanes of events, one grid row per lane
anatomy.event: a with href, button without; tabindex=-1 inside a grid; data-all-day, data-continues-before, data-continues-after, data-clipped-start, data-clipped-end, data-status, data-color, data-open
anatomy.event-time: span; the start, or the range, in the locale's hour cycle
anatomy.event-title: span; truncated with an ellipsis, never removed
anatomy.event-location: span; in the day and list layouts
anatomy.event-meta: span, visually hidden; calendar, status, recurrence and the full time range
anatomy.continuation: span, visually hidden; a multi-day bar continuing through this day
anatomy.more: button tabindex=-1; +N; the trigger of a popover listing every event of the day
anatomy.time-grid: div role=grid, labelled by title; week and day
anatomy.time-head: div role=rowgroup; the part that does not scroll
anatomy.zone: div role=columnheader; the zone's short offset, over the gutter
anatomy.column-header: div role=columnheader; weekday and date; data-today, data-offset-change
anatomy.offset-change: span; the offset change of that day, the full sentence in its name
anatomy.all-day-cell: div role=gridcell; lanes of all-day and multi-day bars
anatomy.gutter: div role=rowheader; its name is the timed row's label, the hours are aria-hidden
anatomy.column: div role=gridcell; one day's timed events; data-today
anatomy.off-hours: div aria-hidden; a stretch of the column outside workingHours, from offHoursOn
anatomy.now: div aria-hidden; the current time line in today's column
anatomy.offset-line: div aria-hidden; the minute the zone's offset changes
anatomy.selection: div aria-hidden; the chosen stretch of a column
anatomy.list-day: section, labelled by its heading; data-today
anatomy.empty: div; the list layout's empty state and the consumer's slot
anatomy.resize-handle: span aria-hidden; the end an edit pulls: the bottom of a block, the inline end of a bar; only on an editable event, where it ends in this drawing

time.values: PlainDate for an all-day event, PlainDateTime for a timed one; the kind of start decides, and there is no allDay flag to contradict it

end.timed: exclusive; an event ending at 00:00 occupies only the day before
end.missing: a point occurrence, drawn at the minimum height with its start alone

time.zone: timeZone decides today, the now line and the gutter's label; unset is the runtime's own
time.conversion: the application's, with wallClockIn(instant, timeZone) from @slotted/core/date

dst.skippedHour: drawn; no conversion produces an event in it
dst.repeatedHour: two events at the same wall-clock time share the place and are laid out as overlapping
dst.duration: wall-clock; a zero-length result is a point occurrence and its name states both times
dst.recurrence: repeats the wall-clock time, as RFC 5545 does with TZID
dst.marker: data-offset-change on the day, offset-change in its header and offset-line at the minute, from offsetChangeOn(date, timeZone)

recurrence.refused: BYSETPOS, BYYEARDAY, BYWEEKNO, BYHOUR, BYMINUTE, BYSECOND and the frequencies below daily
recurrence.parse: total: an unknown key, frequency or malformed value gives null, and the event degrades to a single occurrence
recurrence.first: the start date is always the first occurrence and counts toward COUNT, as DTSTART does
recurrence.exceptions: exceptions on the series (EXDATE); an event with recurrenceOf and occurrence replaces that date (RECURRENCE-ID)
recurrence.key: id, or id@YYYY-MM-DD for an occurrence of a series; a replaced occurrence keeps the key

month.range: the weeks of monthGrid from @slotted/core/date; six with fixedWeeks

week.range: the week holding date from firstDayOfWeek, without Saturday and Sunday under weekends=hidden

day.step: 1 day; skips the weekend under weekends=hidden

list.range: the week or month holding date, by listRange

layout.order: start, then longer first, then all-day before timed, then title by the locale's collator, then key
layout.month: each occurrence takes the first lane free on all its days in the row; maxEvents lanes are drawn and a day with occurrences in hidden lanes shows more, on a line of its own below the lanes
layout.monthTimed: a timed occurrence of one day is a dot, a time and a title with no ground; an all-day or multi-day occurrence is a bar
layout.overlap: columns: occurrences linked by transitive overlap form a cluster; each takes the first column whose last occurrence has ended, then spans the free columns to its end
layout.overflow: a cluster wider than the columns it may take draws one fewer and a more in the last, covering the time of the rest; it may take maxColumns, and never more than blocks of 56 pixels fit in the measured day, with two as soon as the day is 88 pixels wide
layout.clipping: an occurrence outside dayHours is cut with a square edge, data-clipped-start or data-clipped-end, and its name states the full range
layout.crossingMidnight: one segment per day in the time grid; a bar in the month, labelled with its start

focusModel: roving tabindex over the grid's cells; exactly one cell in the tab sequence, the one holding date; widgets inside cells are tabindex=-1

keyboard.effect: month: one day back; time grid: one column back; pages at the edge
keyboard.focus: the new cell

keyboard.effect: month: one day forward; time grid: one column forward; pages at the edge
keyboard.focus: the new cell

keyboard.effect: month: one week back; time grid: the row above (header, all-day, hours)
keyboard.focus: the new cell

keyboard.effect: month: one week forward; time grid: the row below
keyboard.focus: the new cell

keyboard.effect: the first day of the week row, or the first column
keyboard.focus: that cell

keyboard.effect: the last day of the week row, or the last column
keyboard.focus: that cell

keyboard.effect: month: the first day of the month; time grid: as Home
keyboard.focus: that cell

keyboard.effect: month: the last day of the month; time grid: as End
keyboard.focus: that cell

keyboard.effect: one period back; the month clamps the day
keyboard.focus: the cell of the new date

keyboard.effect: one period forward; the month clamps the day
keyboard.focus: the cell of the new date

keyboard.effect: month: one year back
keyboard.focus: the cell of the new date
keyboard.source: APG date picker dialog, carried over from calendar

keyboard.effect: month: one year forward
keyboard.focus: the cell of the new date
keyboard.source: APG date picker dialog, carried over from calendar

keyboard.effect: on a cell: moves into it; on a widget: activates it
keyboard.focus: the cell's first widget; unchanged on a widget
keyboard.source: APG, Editing and Navigating Inside a Cell

keyboard.effect: on a cell: moves into it; on a widget: back to the cell
keyboard.focus: the first widget, or the cell
keyboard.source: APG, Editing and Navigating Inside a Cell

keyboard.effect: with selectionMode range: selects the day, or the slot at scrollTime in the hours row; on a widget: activates it
keyboard.focus: unchanged
keyboard.source: platform for the widget; the family for the cell

keyboard.effect: extends the selection from its anchor: days in the month and the all-day row, one slot in the hours row
keyboard.focus: the cell at the moving end

keyboard.effect: on a widget: back to the cell; on a cell: clears the selection; in a popover: closes it
keyboard.focus: the cell, or the widget that opened the popover
keyboard.source: APG, Editing and Navigating Inside a Cell

keyboard.effect: the previous or next widget of the cell, without wrapping
keyboard.focus: that widget
keyboard.source: the family; APG leaves the keys inside a cell to the author

keyboard.effect: on an editable event: moves it — Left and Right a day, mirrored in RTL; Up and Down a slot in the hours, a week in the month; a destination canDrop refused is passed over for the next allowed one
keyboard.focus: stays on the event, which is found again by its key where it lands
keyboard.source: the family; the alternative to dragging that §2.8 of the feature guide asks for

keyboard.effect: on an editable event: moves its end — a slot in the hours, a day on a bar; a refused end is passed over as a move is
keyboard.focus: stays on the event
keyboard.source: the family; the alternative to the resize handle

keyboard.effect: with a context menu: opens it on the focused event, or on the selection or the day of the focused cell
keyboard.focus: the menu's first item; on close, back to the event or cell

keyboard.effect: leaves the grid
keyboard.focus: the next control after the grid

focus.removed: a widget that disappears while focused (a filter hides the event) returns focus to its cell
focus.popover: closing a popover returns focus to the widget that opened it
focus.view: changing view keeps date and puts the tab stop on its cell; focus stays on the control that asked

wiring.eventName: the event's own content: time, title, then event-meta with the calendar, the status, the recurrence and the full time range
wiring.continuation: each day a multi-day bar crosses after its first holds a visually hidden continuation naming the event
wiring.cellName: aria-labelledby the day-number and a visually hidden count of the day's events
wiring.open: aria-expanded on the event whose detail is open, aria-haspopup=dialog when renderEventDetail is given
wiring.more: aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded; the popover is labelled by the day's full date
wiring.live: the title is a polite region; a keyboard selection is announced once through live-announcer

facts.onRangeChange: { start, end, view } after the visible range changes, the first render included; a fact the family states, not a model

loading.indicator: one indeterminate linear progress-indicator in loader, on the body's top edge
loading.grid: the grid is structure known from the date and stays painted with its real content
loading.events: no skeleton: the position of an event is its data, and a placeholder block would state a time nobody chose
loading.refresh: events already drawn stay until the new ones arrive; the body takes aria-busy
loading.timing: loadingDelay and loadingMinDuration through nextLoadingVisibility of @slotted/core/loading
loading.announcement: one polite message through live-announcer when the indicator appears

workingHours.shape: [{ days: number[], start: PlainTime, end: PlainTime }]; several entries make a split day; end 00:00 is the end of the day
workingHours.grid: off-hours shades the stretches of each column outside them; a day no entry names is data-non-working and shaded whole
workingHours.absent: no entries: every day is a working day and nothing is shaded
workingHours.selection: shading informs and does not refuse: a slot outside working hours can still be selected, because the rule for refusing belongs to the application

dayContent.react: renderDayContent(date, context) returning a node, or null for none
dayContent.angular: ng-template[slEventCalendarDayContent] with the date as its implicit context
dayContent.reason: a booking calendar shows a price, a clinic a count of free slots, a team calendar a holiday: the day header is the one place every domain writes into, and the family cannot know what it holds

compact.threshold: COMPACT_BELOW of @slotted/core/measure (600px), the root's width, by createWidthGate
compact.view: does not change: the list covers the same range, data-layout says list, and the view switcher keeps the chosen view
compact.keep: with compact=keep the grid stays and draws events as marks of color, their names kept for assistive technology; in the month the day number opens the day's events as a sheet
compact.sheets: below the threshold the "+N" panel and the detail are bottom drawers (side=bottom) inside the root rather than popovers: the whole width, a title, a close and the platform's back; a region that contains fixed layers keeps them; focus returns to the widget that opened them

partIdentity.rule: with a context menu the body carries data-ui=context-menu and this family's part name

contextMenu.family: context-menu: the body is its one target (data-ui=context-menu, data-part=body); the menu's items are the application's
contextMenu.react: renderContextMenu(target) returns the items (MenuItem, MenuSeparator, a nested Menu)
contextMenu.angular: ng-template[slEventCalendarContextMenu] let-target holds the items; [slEventCalendarContextMenuFor] narrows the targets that have a menu
contextMenu.target: { kind: 'event', occurrence } on an event; otherwise { kind: 'slot', slot }: the selection when the pointer or the focus is inside it, one step of the hours at the pointer in a timed column, or the day (contextSlot of @slotted/core/event-calendar)
contextMenu.opens: a secondary click, a long press on touch and pen, Shift+F10 and the ContextMenu key on a focused event or cell
contextMenu.anchor: the point pressed; from the keyboard the event, the selection drawn in the column, or the day's header
contextMenu.nothing: a press at no event and no day, or at a target the application gives no items for, is not prevented: the browser's own menu opens
contextMenu.mark: the event carries data-context and is drawn as the solid slot; a stretch is drawn as the selection being made; the family's inward mark is set to nothing on the body
contextMenu.label: the menu is labelled by the event's title or by the stretch in words

runtimeProperties.name: --slotted-event-lane
runtimeProperties.value: the grid row of its lane, from 1

runtimeProperties.name: --slotted-event-span
runtimeProperties.value: days a bar covers in its row, or columns a block spans

runtimeProperties.name: --slotted-event-start
runtimeProperties.value: minutes from the first visible hour

runtimeProperties.name: --slotted-event-length
runtimeProperties.value: minutes it lasts inside the visible hours

runtimeProperties.name: --slotted-event-column
runtimeProperties.value: its column in the cluster, from 0

runtimeProperties.name: --slotted-event-calendar-lanes
runtimeProperties.value: the lanes drawn in the row

runtimeProperties.name: --slotted-event-calendar-slot
runtimeProperties.value: slotDuration in minutes, 5 to 120: the period of the lighter rules

declined.resources: deferred to resource-scheduler, §16: the resource model — people and rooms side by side, conflicts and capacity — belongs to that package
declined.singleLetterShortcuts: declined: the calendar lives in a page with shortcuts of its own, and a bare letter inside a grid collides with a screen reader's quick navigation
declined.secondZone: declined: a second gutter would need instants, which the library does not hold
declined.arbitraryColor: declined: color is a calendar's slot of the data scale, never a value (docs/component-features.md §2.4)

color: the calendar's position in calendars, from 1, no cycling

container.name: slotted-event-calendar
container.reflow: under 480px the header puts the title on a row of its own above the controls

literals.hourSize: two small control heights: a thirty-minute slot is one small control tall, so density shrinks the grid as it shrinks a control; arithmetic over tokens
literals.tint: 14%: the share of a calendar's slot mixed into the surface under an event, the smallest share that separates the eight slots from each other on a white page; a data slot has no surface role to read, which is the reason --slotted-highlight-tint-opacity documents
literals.tintHover: 21% and 27%: hover and press, seven and thirteen points over the rest; the edge takes 34% at rest and 50% on hover, and the dark scheme takes 24, 32, 38 and 44, 60 through light-dark()
literals.scrollerSize: 40rem: the hours' block size when the root is given none, ten comfortable hours; a root with a definite height gives the scroller the rest of it
literals.columnCounts: 7 and the day count are the shape of a week, not a value a theme retunes

dataAttributes.data-date: YYYY-MM-DD on every cell and list day: the day it stands for
dataAttributes.data-row: day, header, all-day or timed on every grid cell: which row of the grid it is in
dataAttributes.data-key: the occurrence key on an event
dataAttributes.data-layout: grid or list: what is drawn, which differs from data-view below the compact size class
dataAttributes.data-today: the day, column or list day holding today in timeZone
dataAttributes.data-outside-month: a day of the month either side
dataAttributes.data-non-working: a day no workingHours entry names
dataAttributes.data-offset-change: the zone's offset changes on this day
dataAttributes.data-continues-before: a bar or segment that began before this row or day
dataAttributes.data-continues-after: a bar or segment that goes on after this row or day
dataAttributes.data-clipped-start: an occurrence that begins before the visible hours
dataAttributes.data-clipped-end: an occurrence that ends after the visible hours
dataAttributes.data-status: tentative or cancelled; confirmed writes nothing
dataAttributes.data-color: the calendar's slot, 1 to 8; absent is the neutral
dataAttributes.data-bar: an event drawn across days in a lane: all-day, or a timed one crossing midnight in the month
dataAttributes.data-short: a block in a column shorter than 45 minutes, which puts its time after its title on one line
dataAttributes.data-slot-duration: on the root: the minutes between the column’s lighter rules, 5 to 120
dataAttributes.data-editable: an event the reader can move and resize in a grid
dataAttributes.data-dragging: the event a pointer is moving, drawn where it would land
dataAttributes.data-drop-invalid: on the event being dragged, while canDrop refuses where it would land
dataAttributes.data-past: on an event that ended before now: drawn a step back
dataAttributes.data-context: on the event a context menu is open on: drawn as the solid slot, as the open event is

editing.who: editable: a boolean, or a predicate per occurrence; the family holds no event
editing.request: onEventChange / eventChangeRequest: { key, event, occurrence, recurring, kind: move | resize, start, end } in the kind the event holds, with reason pointer or keyboard, cancellable; the application answers by changing events
editing.notAModel: deliberately not mutable, for the reason read and removable are not: the event lives in the application's store, and a family that moved it itself would show it moved while the store still held it where it was
editing.pointer: a press that travels four pixels picks the event up; in the hours the pointer's height gives minutes, snapped to slotDuration, and the column under it the day; in the month and the all-day row the cell under it gives the day; the resize handle moves the end only
editing.preview: the occurrence is laid out where it would land, with withPlacement, and marked data-dragging; Escape during the drag puts it back and asks for nothing
editing.shortest: a resize never makes an event shorter than one slot, or one day for an all-day event
editing.recurring: an occurrence of a series is asked for with its original date in occurrence; whether the move applies to the occurrence or to the series is the application's
editing.announce: an accepted request is announced once: the title and its new range
editing.canDrop: canDrop(change) returns whether a destination is allowed, and reads the change onEventChange would receive; the pointer asks it at every step of a drag, and a refused destination marks the event data-drop-invalid and the root's cursor not-allowed, where letting go puts the event back and asks for nothing; Alt+Arrow asks each step with nextAllowedPlacement from @slotted/core/event-calendar and lands on the first allowed one, and with none in reach the event stays and dropInvalid is announced; absent, every destination is allowed
editing.canDropShape: one object for both questions: ReUI asks canDropEvent while dragging and onEventUpdate after, with two shapes; here the change that canDrop allowed is the change onEventChange receives
